violations.text: The Person in charge did not assure compliance with critical code requirements. New Violation. Correct By: 09/03/2026
Employees were observed changing gloves without washing their hands. Food employees must wash their hands before putting on gloves. New Violation. Correct By: 08/20/2026

The hand-washing sink in the service area was blocked by a box of plastic wrap. A hand-washing sink shall be accessible at all times for employee use. PIC removed. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 08/20/2026

The drain to the sushi display case was observed draining into the handwashing sink in the service area. A hand-washing sink must not be used for purposes other than hand washing. PIC removed the drain tube. New Violation. Correct By: 08/20/2026

Soap was not available at the hand-washing sink in the service area. Hand-washing sinks must be provided with a supply of hand cleaning liquid, powder, or bar soap. New Violation. Correct By: 08/20/2026

Food contact surfaces of equipment/utensils (ice machine) were observed with an accumulation of biofilm debris. The food contact surfaces of equipment must be clean to sight and touch. PIC stated ice is used only to chill pre-packaged (canned/bottled) beverages. Ice machine to be taken out of service to be cleaned and sanitized. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 08/15/2024

Per interview of staff, equipment is only washed, rinsed, and sanitized at the end of the day. The surfaces of equipment that contacts time/temperature control for safety (TCS) foods such as fish, meats and cheeses must be washed, rinsed, and sanitized at least every four hours. New Violation. Correct By: 08/20/2026

Recently prepared tempura was observed held on the counter at 84 degrees F. PIC was informed to keep cold (41 degrees f or colder) or hot (135 degrees F or warmer). PIC placed tempura in refrigerator. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 08/20/2026
ROP fish was observed thawing in refrigerator with packaging intact. PIC informed to remove from packaging. Corrected On-Site. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 08/15/2024

Working containers of sauce bottles and dry storage containers are not labeled with the common name of the food. Working containers holding food or food ingredients that are removed from their original packages, such as flour, herbs, salt, sugar, and spices must be labeled with the common name of the food. New Violation. Correct By: 09/03/2026

Staff were observed not wearing hair restraints. Food employees must wear hair restraints such as hats, hair coverings, or nets that are worn to effectively keep their hair from contacting exposed food, clean equipment/utensils, linens, and unwrapped single-service and single-use articles. New Violation. Correct By: 09/03/2026

The concentration of the sanitizer solution for the wet wiping cloths was 0 parts per million (ppm). The required concentration for chlorine sanitizer is 50-100 ppm. PIC stated that the sani bucket needed to be changed. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 08/20/2026

Bowls are being used as scoops in containers of rice and flour. Utensils used to dispense non-time/temperature control for safety (TCS) foods such as sugar and flour must be stored in the food item with their handles above the top of the food within the container. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 08/15/2024

The following were observed in poor repair: -refrigerator gaskets (torn, loose, held with tape; repeat) -refrigerator door handle (held with tape; repeat) -2 door low boy (non-functional) -sushi display case (non-functional at time of inspection, cracked door). New Violation. Correct By: 09/24/2026

The non-food contact surfaces of the following have an accumulation of dust, dirt, food residue, and other debris:-rice and flour storage containers-chest cooler-multiple pieces of equipment (rice cookers, etc)-shelving. New Violation. Correct By: 09/03/2026
Cold water was not available at the 3-bay sink. New Violation. Correct By: 09/03/2026

The following have an accumulation of soil residue and/or food debris:-floors and walls throughout the facility -both hand-washing sinks. The physical facilities shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. New Violation. Correct By: 09/03/2026

Food contact surfaces of equipment/utensils (ice machine) were observed with an accumulation of debris. The food contact surfaces of equipment must be clean to sight and touch. Ice disposed. Unit taken out of service to be washed and sanitized. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 08/15/2024
ROP fish observed thawing with package still intact. PIC informed and cut opening in package. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 08/15/2024

Bowls are being used as scoops in containers of (dry ingredients). Utensils used to dispense non-time/temperature control for safety (TCS) foods such as sugar and flour must be stored in the food item with their handles above the top of the food within the container. New Violation. Correct By: 08/15/2024
Refrigerator door gaskets and handles were observed in poor repair. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 08/26/2024
The non-food contact surfaces of the food storage shelves have an accumulation of food residue and small accumulation of rodent droppings. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 08/19/2024

The walls behind prep table have an accumulation of soil residue and grease. The physical facilities shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 08/22/2024
